notes: Full-feature OWASP Top 10 audit of 13-funnels-tooling (final state of T1 b313524, T2 76237e0+5eb47cc, T3 d356f55, T4 8a5e92e, T5 e6f765d, T6 1aa1bc2). All 6 threat vectors confirmed safe. (A01/IDOR) All 4 new POSTs route through FunnelService.requireFunnel as the FIRST guard, which calls ProjectService.requireOwned(ownerId,...) then proves the funnel belongs to the path project; foreign/missing/soft-deleted/cross-project all collapse to a uniform 404 (MESSAGE_NOT_FOUND), malformed ObjectId hex too (no existence oracle, never 403). ownerId derives ONLY from currentUserId() (session SecurityContext), never from path/body. test-run/preview: requireFunnel-404 precedes 422 and stepId-404 (FunnelService.previewStep / testRun order; IT previewIdorPrecedenceOver422AndStepId404, *ForeignFunnelReturns404, crossProjectFunnelReturnsUniform404, malformed*Returns404). (A01 test-run cross-tenant) direct-enroll via insertExecution(depth=0) bypasses ONLY trigger matching, not tenant isolation: projectId/funnel/telegramBotId all derive from the owned funnel + that project's CONNECTED bot; subscriber resolved project-scoped via findByChat(projectId, telegramBotId, ownerChatId) filtered ACTIVE; cancelExistingForPair + insertExecution scoped projectId+funnelId+subscriberId. No way to enroll a foreign subscriber or into a foreign funnel. (A01 stop-all) cancelInFlightExecutions updateMulti scoped by BOTH projectId AND funnelId (fail-closed; IT stopAllScopedByProjectAndFunnel proves a sibling project/funnel execution is untouched). (A03 XSS) preview escaping is computed server-side by VariableTemplateRenderer.render byte-for-byte with the runtime (parseMode null=no escape, HTML escapes & < > ", MarkdownV2 escapes full special set incl. backslash, single-pass, author markup intentionally not escaped). Frontend FunnelMessagePreview.vue outputs rendered string as TEXT ONLY via {{ rendered.rendered }} interpolation; grep across components/funnels and funnels pages shows v-html/innerHTML appear only in convention comments, never as real sinks; vitest no-v-html assert (T6). No client-side substitution/escaping drift in TS/Vue. (Sensitive data) PreviewStepResponse is strictly {rendered, sampleData, kind}; StopAllResponse {cancelled}; FunnelResponse carries no ownerChatId/bot-token/telegramBotId/webhook-secret. No Bot entity is serialized into any response (only getOwnerChatId/getTelegramBotId/getTelegramUsername are read internally); Bot.webhookSecretHash is a hash and has no toString/accessor in any feature DTO. funnel_owner_not_linked (422) collapses all three unlinked branches to one code, leaking only the boolean fact of non-linkage (intended remediation), never owner identity. (CSRF) New POSTs sit on /api/v1/... under the @Order(2) session chain with CookieCsrfTokenRepository + CsrfTokenRequestAttributeHandler; scoped CSRF-disable is limited to /webhooks/telegram/{projectId} (negated matcher) and the @Order(1) stateless /api/integrations/** key chain — funnel paths are NOT excluded. Frontend useApi attaches X-XSRF-TOKEN for all non-safe methods; all 4 store actions go through it. IT exercises every endpoint .with(csrf()). Accepted known-risk (not a new finding): Epic-04b first-/start-wins ownerChatId race is inherited 04b trust model, explicitly out of scope per tech-spec Risks. No fixer task required.
